# Holographic

An iridescent perimeter around calm, legible content.

## Use

Use for creative technology, portfolio highlights, and product announcements.

## Essential traits

- Iridescent accents
- Opaque reading zone
- Subtle angle-based color variation

## Typography

System sans-serif with crisp bold headings.

## Layout and surfaces

Iridescent accents at edges, simple information hierarchy inside. Rainbow border treatment over opaque dark violet panels.

## Palette

- background: #111020
- surface: #211e34
- text: #f9f6ff
- muted: #cec6e3
- accent: #e6d5ff
- border: #827596

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Holographic to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System sans-serif with crisp bold headings. Iridescent accents at edges, simple information hierarchy inside. Rainbow border treatment over opaque dark violet panels. Palette: background #111020, surface #211e34, text #f9f6ff, muted #cec6e3, accent #e6d5ff, border #827596. Essential traits: Iridescent accents; Opaque reading zone; Subtle angle-based color variation. Avoid: Rainbow body text; Unstable contrast; Full-surface glare. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
